purpose: Small, labeled, reproducible corpus establishing M0 baselines (latency, recall@k, recall-per-token, stale/contradiction handling) so M1-M6 have regression gates. Corpus identity is fixed; do not mutate in place - version-bump to v2 if content changes.
notes: Facts are deliberate store_fact-style rows (entity/key/value). Queries carry ground-truth relevant fact ids. Stale/contradiction pairs test that retrieval prefers the fresh fact and hides the superseded one (freshness decay + supersession are existing daemon behaviour; this measures the pre-M1 baseline).

facts.value: corecruxd serves its HTTP API on port 14800
corecruxd serves gRPC on port 4007 for append, replay, and export
the built-in MCP server listens on port 14801
BM25 text search runs over sealed .ccxi companion indexes, zero LLM calls
the dense lane is a free uncapped local CPU cosine capability via a pluggable DenseProvider
every retrieval call takes a mandatory token_budget that caps returned context deterministically
CROWN receipts are Ed25519-signed and offline-verifiable with no daemon
facts decay by a deterministic freshness horizon; stale facts are demoted in ranking but never hard-deleted
consolidation supersedes facts reversibly; the input store is never modified in place
the multi-agent coordination plane is enabled by default and stores coordination as born-private facts
coordination offers presence, a work board, signed handoffs, and path leases
community packs run out-of-process or WASM-sandboxed with per-passport capability grants and signed pinned artifacts
the sealed local ingest door accepts folder and file payloads at /v1/local/ingest
the provider-neutral context bundle is served at /v1/context for cross-provider recall
the activity log is replayable and each turn can be co-signed for tamper-evidence
auto-extracted facts land as reviewable candidates in a review namespace and are never promoted unscored
two REST SDKs cover facts, sessions, and query against the daemon
every benchmark result must name its corpus by identity or the number is unattributable
the production daemon is deployed on host crux under /opt/crux and tracks tagged releases
the daemon is source-available under the CueCrux Community Licence, not open-source

stale_contradiction_pairs.stale_value: the consolidation review scheduler runs every 3600 seconds by default
stale_contradiction_pairs.fresh_value: the buyer-fit eval profile runs the consolidation review scheduler every 900 seconds
stale_contradiction_pairs.expect: a query for the review interval returns the fresh 900s fact; the stale 3600s fact is demoted/superseded, not surfaced as current

stale_contradiction_pairs.stale_value: local ingest defaults to OFF and its route returns 404
stale_contradiction_pairs.fresh_value: local ingest defaults to ON via env_default_on; its route is live unless explicitly disabled
stale_contradiction_pairs.expect: a query for the local-ingest default returns the fresh ON fact; the stale OFF fact is not surfaced as current

queries.q: what port does the HTTP API use
how does text search avoid LLM calls
where do auto-extracted facts go before promotion
why must a benchmark name its corpus
how often does the consolidation review scheduler run under the eval profile
is local ingest on or off by default

metrics_to_capture.latency_ms: p50 and p95 over all queries, measured client-side
metrics_to_capture.recall_at_5: fraction of queries whose relevant ids all appear in the top 5 results
metrics_to_capture.recall_per_token: recall_at_5 divided by mean returned-context tokens (honest accounting; token_budget fixed at 500)
metrics_to_capture.stale_contradiction_recall: fraction of the 2 stale/contradiction queries that return the FRESH fact and NOT the stale one as current
metrics_to_capture.capture_reliability: N/A at M0 - auto-extraction does not exist yet (this is the M1 build); recorded as the zero point
